resources.string: Show a dimmed clock above the current screen
Overlay is active. Hide it from the notification, or turn the switch off.
To get a real always-on-clock behaviour (it turns on itself when the phone is idle), pick AlwaysON as the system screen saver. It is most useful while the phone charges or sits in a dock.
If “AlwaysON clock” is not in the list, enable the screen saver first, then choose it and set the start condition to “While docked and charging”.
The clock is shown over the screen

On unrooted Android there is no public API to draw a true always-on image with the screen off (that needs the manufacturer AOD). This app gives you the two closest supported things: the overlay for a night-stand clock while the screen is on, and the screen saver that auto-shows the clock when the phone is idle and charging. Battery shown may refresh with a delay.
